system: OBSERVABILITY / API — Audit Viewer diagnostic boundary
requirements: Audit Log is the accountable user/system action record and requires actor, role, action, target, request/trace and outcome.
Audit Viewer is read-only and backend permissions must be enforced independently of UI.
Audit evidence/persistence failure must fail closed; no success response may bypass immutable audit evidence.

packages/api/canonical.ts.why: The audit read handler swallowed every database/transform/canonical-read failure and exposed only a generic 500, so exact-head runtime diagnosis could not distinguish an attribution failure from a persistence failure.
packages/api/canonical.ts.spec_requirement: Keep fail-closed audit behavior while retaining accountable, correlated diagnostics.
packages/api/canonical.ts.old_behavior: catch { errorResponse(...500, DEPENDENCY_FAILURE, Audit persistence unavailable) } with no server-side stable diagnostic code.
packages/api/canonical.ts.new_behavior: Classify only allow-listed-shaped error codes or AUDIT_* invariant messages, emit code/request_id/trace_id to stderr, and keep the same generic 500 response.
packages/api/canonical.ts.security_impact: No raw error text, database details, or secrets are emitted; fail-closed response is unchanged.
packages/api/canonical.ts.determinism_impact: No authoritative state or ordering change.
packages/api/canonical.ts.test_impact: Contract test verifies stable P2028 logging, request/trace correlation, and absence of the raw error message.

tests/contract/canonical-api.test.ts.why: The diagnostic boundary itself needed regression coverage.
tests/contract/canonical-api.test.ts.spec_requirement: Diagnostics must be correlated and non-sensitive while preserving the fail-closed contract.
tests/contract/canonical-api.test.ts.old_behavior: No assertion that a runtime failure produces a safe diagnostic.
tests/contract/canonical-api.test.ts.new_behavior: Mocks a coded persistence error and asserts 500 plus safe code/correlation output without raw detail.
tests/contract/canonical-api.test.ts.security_impact: Negative assertion prevents raw persistence details from leaking.
tests/contract/canonical-api.test.ts.test_impact: Contract suite includes the new diagnostic assertion.

proven_gap: Exact previous browser deployments returned HTTP 500 from GET /api/audit-logs and did not expose the internal reason.
Current handler catch block previously discarded the caught error.
The exact-head deployment now logs AUDIT_ROLE_ATTRIBUTION_MISSING for the failing browser requests.

At HEAD 4f4f375, the baseline audit migration creates audit_log without role, while the later role migration adds role nullable for historical rows; auditTruthRows intentionally fails closed when a returned row has null role.
scripts/seed-browser-e2e.mjs seeds identities/project/artifact/revision but does not create or isolate audit_log history.

runtime_diagnosis.proven: The 500 is caused by a returned audit_log row with role=null, rejected by auditTruthRows as AUDIT_ROLE_ATTRIBUTION_MISSING. The service remains fail-closed.
runtime_diagnosis.source_alignment: DOC-B AuditLog schema requires role. The baseline migration historically created audit_log without role; the later migration preserves nullable role because historical role cannot be safely guessed.
not_proven: Aggregate count and identities of null-role rows in the connected Postgres database.
Whether the persistent deployment database or another bootstrap path introduced the rows.
A safe remediation for immutable legacy rows without external operator/database action.
